name: Amazon.com Inc
notes: Borderline/mostly compliant. Muslim Xchange and Islamicly say yes, Musaffa says doubtful. DP ratio 4.51% — very close to 5% ceiling. AWS cloud is clean but Amazon has financial services (Amazon Lending, BNPL), sells alcohol, and has Prime Video content. Held in SPUS halal ETF. Could arguably be marked COMPLIANT per user guidance (lean toward inclusion), but the 4.51% ratio being so close to the 5% limit warrants caution.
